ideas.name: Dealer Inventory Treasury Price Pressure
ideas.claim: Net dealer Treasury inventories are associated with temporary pressure on Treasury yields.
ideas.quote: Net positive (negative) dealer inventories are associated with higher (lower) market yields.
ideas.mechanism: Dealer inventory constraints and compensation for holding interest-rate risk.
ideas.claimed_result: The authors estimate that dealers' typically short Treasury exposure reduced the 10-year Treasury yield by nearly 5 basis points on average during 2001–2013.
required_data: Dealer Treasury cash and futures inventories
